name: Answers Core
description: Core Answers features: the Question node type, Answer/comment bundles, tags field, comment field formatter and theming for the Answers Q&A system.
project_description: Answers Core is the submodule that provides all functionality of the Answers Q&A project; the top-level 'answers' module only depends on it. It installs, from config/install, an 'answers_question' node type (the Question), a free-tagging 'answers_tags' taxonomy reference to the Tags vocabulary, and three comment bundles that model the discussion: 'answers_answer' (an answer, attached to the question node through the 'answers' comment field), 'answers_question_comment' (comments on a question) and 'answers_comment' (comments on an answer, i.e. a comment on a comment). It adds one plugin, the AnswersFormatter comment field formatter (id 'answers_answer', extending core CommentDefaultFormatter), which renders the answer thread and inline add-answer form while honoring core 'access comments'/'post comments' permissions. Hooks (hook_theme, hook_preprocess, hook_node_links_alter, hook_comment_links_alter, hook_module_implements_alter) compute the answer-count heading, a relative 'Asked … ago' timestamp, an optional Statistics 'Viewed N times' line, and strip core reply/statistics links. A small library (answers_core/node: CSS + jQuery behavior) reveals inline comment forms on click, and Twig overrides give a Stack-Overflow-like layout. It declares core dependencies text, menu_ui, node, field_ui, comment, taxonomy, path, views and filter. It provides no routes, no permissions.yml, no services and no custom queries.
